facts.text: The St. Regis Residence Club is only a few steps from the base of Aspen Mountain's slopes.
facts.excerpt: Only a few steps from the base of Aspen Mountain's renowned slopes, the St. Regis Residence Club is defined by its premier amenities and personalized service.

facts.text: The residences are in the heart of Aspen, within walking distance of the town's main attractions, including boutiques and restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Situated in the heart of town, the residences are within walking distance of all the main attractions, including charming boutiques and world-class restaurants.

facts.text: Guests can use the resort's outdoor heated pool and hot tub, open all year long.
facts.excerpt: guests can enjoy the resort's premier facilities, including an outdoor...See More heated pool and a hot tub open all year long.

facts.text: Guests can use RAKxa Wellness Spa, which is located within The St. Regis Aspen Resort.
facts.excerpt: RAKxa Wellness Spa, located within The St. Regis Aspen Resort, provides an experience beyond relaxation.

facts.text: RAKxa Wellness Spa is pitched as a place to recover from the slopes or retreat from everyday stress.
facts.excerpt: Whether you seek to recover from the slopes or retreat from everyday stress, RAKxa Wellness Spa provides space, understanding, and time to rebalance.

facts.text: Two-bedroom residences have one king bed in the first bedroom, two twin beds in the second and a sofa bed.
facts.excerpt: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Bedroom 2: 2 Twin, Alternate: sofa bed

facts.text: Three-bedroom residences have a king bed in each of the three bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Bedroom 2: 1 King, Bedroom 3: 1 King

facts.text: Several residence types sleep up to eight guests.
facts.excerpt: There are a number of room types with the largest occupancy of 8 at St. Regis Residence Club, Aspen.

facts.text: Residences have a refrigerator.
facts.excerpt: Yes, rooms at St. Regis Residence Club, Aspen have a Refrigerator.

facts.text: Residences have a coffee and tea maker.
facts.excerpt: Yes, rooms at St. Regis Residence Club, Aspen have a Coffee/tea maker.

facts.text: Mountain Social Bar & Lounge is known for its apres-ski scene.
facts.excerpt: Known for its après ski scene, Mountain Social Bar & Lounge puts an elegantly approachable touch to fine dining in Aspen, Colorado.

facts.text: Mountain Social Bar & Lounge holds a daily champagne sabering and serves a signature St. Regis Bloody Mary.
facts.excerpt: Experience our daily champagne sabering or sip on a signature St. Regis Bloody Mary at our restaurant in downtown Aspen.

facts.text: The Velvet Buck uses local, seasonal ingredients in a fusion of multiple cuisines.
facts.excerpt: Velvet Buck utilizes local, seasonal ingredients to create an exquisite fusion of multiple cuisines.

facts.text: The Snow Lodge is a wintertime entertainment concept from the team behind The Surf Lodge in Montauk.
facts.excerpt: The team behind iconic Montauk destination, The Surf Lodge, conceives a wintertime, entertainment concept, The Snow Lodge our Aspen luxury hotel with bar.

facts.text: The Snow Lodge is a supper club with programming of music, food, art and wellness.
facts.excerpt: This supper club is home to a thoughtfully curated programming of music, food, art, and wellness.

facts.text: The Splash Pool Bar offers food and beverage service, weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: This Pool Bar in Aspen, CO, offers food and beverage service, weather permitting.

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel with fitness center in Aspen, CO features state-of-the-art Technogym equipment

facts.text: Room service is not offered at the St. Regis Residence Club.
facts.excerpt: No, room service is not offered at St. Regis Residence Club, Aspen.

facts.text: Guests can enjoy culinary creations at Velvet Buck or through in-room dining.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy delicious culinary creations at Velvet Bucks or through in-room dining

facts.text: The residences do not have a work space.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at St. Regis Residence Club, Aspen do not have a work space.

facts.text: Pets are welcome.
